gael_cook_10.m: I could use some extra gold. So I can cook them for you for let's say 30 gold a piece.
r: Well, here is 1 piece and 30 gold.
OK, I have 5 pieces and 150 gold.
Here, I have 10 pieces that I would like cooked. Here are 300 gold pieces too.
I'm hungry! Here are 20 pieces and 600 gold.
Oh, my mistake, I forgot that I have no meat.
Oops, I'm still poor. I can't afford to pay your price.

get_five_cooked_meat.m: Just five? That's no problem. Here's all your cooked meat.

get_one_cooked_meat.m: Only one? That's no problem. Here's your cooked meat.

get_ten_cooked_meat.m: 10 meat at once? That's no problem. Here's all your cooked meat.

get_twenty_cooked_meat.m: 20 meat at once?! You may even love this stuff more than I do. Here's all your cooked meat.

kendelow_1.m: I heard that you helped us get rid of that witch Algangror. Thank you.

kendelow_2.m: Welcome to my tavern. I hope you will find your stay a pleasant one.

kendelow_3.m: Most people here in Remgard tend to their crops. Other than that, I hear that Arnal the armorer over on the western shore has some good business trading.

kendelow_4.m: Also, we usually get a lot of visitors here in the tavern. Lately, it has been a lot fewer people in here though, with the closing of the bridge because of those missing people and all.

kendelow_5.m: On your way in, maybe you noticed that we even have a visit from the Knights of Elythom here in the tavern? It seems that more and more people are becoming aware of the hospitality of Remgard.
r: Thank you. I had some other questions.

kendelow_d.m: How may I be of service?
r: What is there to do around here?
Do you have anything to trade?
Actually, I am wondering if it would be possible if I could cook some meat in your kitchen?

kendelow_meat.m: No, sorry. I can't let you use my kitchen. But...

kendelow_room_2.m: You have already rented my last room. We don't have any more rooms other than that one.

kendelow_room_3.m: Why, yes, as a matter of fact, there is. I have one very fine room available upstairs.

kendelow_room_4.m: The previous tenant left in a hurry some days ago.

kendelow_room_5.m: You may rent the room for as long as you like for only 600 gold.
r: 600 gold, are you mad!? That's a fortune.
Is there anything you can do to lower the price?
I'll take it. Here is the gold.
I don't have that much gold.

kendelow_room_6a.m: The price is fixed. I cannot go around handing out discounts to just anyone. Also, keep in mind that you may rent it for as long as you wish.
r: I'll take it. Here is the gold.
I don't have that much gold.

kendelow_room_6b.m: Since you helped us here in Remgard with that witch Algangror, I am prepared to offer you a discount. How about we say 400 gold for it instead?
r: I'll take it. Here is the gold.
I don't have that much gold.

kendelow_room_7.m: You are welcome to return once you have the gold, if you are still interested.

kendelow_room_8.m: Thank you. The room is upstairs. You may rent it for as long as you wish.

kendelow_shop.m: Oh sure. Here, have a look.

remgard2.10: I have told Jhaeld, the village elder in Remgard, about the woman named Algangror that lives in the abandoned house to the east along the northern shore of the lake outside Remgard.
remgard2.20: Jhaeld told me that he would rather not deal with her, since he believes she is very dangerous. For the sake of his guards, he will not risk going against her since he is afraid of what might happen to all of them.
remgard2.21: If I want to help Jhaeld and the people of Remgard, I should find a way to make Algangror disappear. He also warns me to be extremely careful.
remgard2.30: Algangror admitted to me that she had made some people disappear from Remgard. She would not tell me what happened to them though.
remgard2.35: I have started attacking Algangror. I should return to Jhaeld with proof of defeating her when she is dead.
remgard2.40: I have told Jhaeld that I defeated Algangror.
remgard2.41: Jhaeld was very pleased to hear the good news. The people of Remgard should now be safe, and the town can be opened to outsiders again.
remgard2.45: For helping the people of Remgard find the cause of the disappearing people, Jhaeld told me to talk to Rothses. He might be able to improve some of my equipment.
remgard2.46: Ervelyn, the Remgard tailor, gave me a feathered hat as thanks for helping the people of Remgard find out what happened to the missing people.
